```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 220
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
})

results_root <- Sys.getenv("URBAN_FACTOR_RESULTS_ROOT", unset = "../results/urban_factor_experiments")
fig_dir <- file.path(results_root, "figures")

read_optional <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.size(path) == 0) return(tibble())
  suppressWarnings(read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE))
}

as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  tolower(as.character(x)) %in% c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}

fmt <- function(x, digits = 4) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "f", digits = digits))
}

yn <- function(x) ifelse(as_flag(x), "是", "否")
clean_text <- function(x, n = 240) {
  out <- substr(as.character(x), 1, n)
  gsub("[`|]", "", out)
}

label_sum <- read_optional(file.path(results_root, "01_label_data", "label_factor_summary.csv"))
projection_sum <- read_optional(file.path(results_root, "02_graph_projection", "projection_factor_summary.csv"))
form_sum <- read_optional(file.path(results_root, "03_urban_form", "urban_form_factor_summary.csv"))
decision <- read_optional(file.path(results_root, "city_decision_matrix.csv"))
failures <- read_optional(file.path(results_root, "failure_manifest.csv"))
manifest <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(results_root, "manifest.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)

if (nrow(decision) == 0) {
  all_cities <- tibble(city = unique(c(label_sum$city, projection_sum$city, form_sum$city))) |>
    filter(!is.na(city), city != "")
  decision <- all_cities |>
    left_join(label_sum, by = "city", suffix = c("", "_label")) |>
    left_join(projection_sum, by = "city", suffix = c("", "_projection")) |>
    left_join(form_sum, by = "city", suffix = c("", "_form"))
  for (nm in c("city_label", "city_label_projection", "city_label_form")) {
    if (!nm %in% names(decision)) decision[[nm]] <- NA_character_
  }
  for (nm in c(
    "label_unstable", "class_composition_sensitive", "label_task_mismatch_possible",
    "edge_attr_not_used", "projection_rule_sensitive", "spatial_geometry_confound",
    "form_mediated_edge_signal", "form_or_distance_confound", "independent_edge_semantics_supported"
  )) {
    if (!nm %in% names(decision)) decision[[nm]] <- FALSE
  }
  decision <- decision |>
    mutate(
      city_label = coalesce(city_label, city_label_projection, city_label_form, city),
      label_unstable = as_flag(label_unstable),
      class_composition_sensitive = as_flag(class_composition_sensitive),
      label_task_mismatch_possible = as_flag(label_task_mismatch_possible),
      edge_attr_not_used = as_flag(edge_attr_not_used),
      projection_rule_sensitive = as_flag(projection_rule_sensitive),
      spatial_geometry_confound = as_flag(spatial_geometry_confound),
      form_mediated_edge_signal = as_flag(form_mediated_edge_signal),
      form_or_distance_confound = as_flag(form_or_distance_confound),
      independent_edge_semantics_supported = as_flag(independent_edge_semantics_supported),
      decision_group = case_when(
        edge_attr_not_used | form_or_distance_confound ~ "negative control",
        projection_rule_sensitive | spatial_geometry_confound ~ "projection-risk diagnostic",
        independent_edge_semantics_supported & !label_unstable & !class_composition_sensitive ~ "main anchor",
        label_task_mismatch_possible | label_unstable | class_composition_sensitive ~ "candidate after V4",
        TRUE ~ "not recommended"
      )
    )
}

city_evidence <- decision |>
  mutate(
    label_evidence = paste0(
      "downsample不稳=", yn(label_unstable),
      "; 类别敏感=", yn(class_composition_sensitive),
      "; 粗粒度增强=", yn(label_task_mismatch_possible)
    ),
    projection_evidence = paste0(
      "edge_attr未被稳定使用=", yn(edge_attr_not_used),
      "; 投影规则敏感=", yn(projection_rule_sensitive),
      "; 几何混杂=", yn(spatial_geometry_confound)
    ),
    form_evidence = paste0(
      "形态介导=", yn(form_mediated_edge_signal),
      "; 匹配后消失=", yn(form_or_distance_confound),
      "; 匹配后仍稳定=", yn(independent_edge_semantics_supported)
    )
  ) |>
  select(city_label, decision_group, label_evidence, projection_evidence, form_evidence)
```

# Urban 3-Factor Experiment Packages

**核心结论。** 全 13 个 Urban 城市的三类诊断已经跑通，且没有城市级失败。当前结果更支持“Urban 是可用于构图机制研究和数据筛选的数据源”，而不是“所有城市都能直接作为主 GNN 聚类实验的正例”。因此下一步应把城市分成 main anchor、candidate after V4、negative control、projection-risk diagnostic 和 not recommended 五类，再决定哪些城市进入主模型 ablation。

# 1. 这组实验回答什么问题

本报告把 Urban 数据的可用性问题拆成三个一级因素：**label/data**、**graph projection** 和 **urban form**。这种拆分的目的不是证明某个 GNN 主模型已经有效，而是先证明“边是否有机会承载独立、可解释、可重复的城市语义”。如果一个城市只是在原始标签比例、投影规则或距离密度上显得有效，它不应直接进入主模型 ablation。

本次执行固定为 CPU 诊断：Python 使用 `/home/aitx/miniconda3/envs/gnn/bin/python`，R 使用 `conda run -n r Rscript`，并强制 `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''`。派生 graph dataset 写到外部数据目录，避免污染 repo 内 `data/`。

```{r run-scope}
scope_tbl <- tibble(
  item = c("城市范围", "seeds", "max_edges", "结果目录", "派生图目录"),
  value = c(
    paste(manifest$cities, collapse = ", "),
    as.character(manifest$seeds),
    as.character(manifest$max_edges),
    as.character(manifest$results_root),
    as.character(manifest$derived_graph_root)
  )
)
kable(scope_tbl, caption = "Run scope and path policy.")
```

# 2. 三类一级因素的实验设计

**Label/data 实验包**检查同一个图在标签口径改变后是否仍然稳定。label downsampling 测试已知标签覆盖率降低时 edge gain 是否剧烈波动；class-balanced probe 检查 same-label / different-label 或 label-pair 组成是否主导结论；coarse label probe 检查原始 top-1 land-use 是否过细，导致有意义的功能边被 same-label 任务低估。

**Graph projection 实验包**检查边是不是由构图规则人工制造出来的。v3b relation intervention 逐一删除 street、junction、geom、building 关系，并将 relation bits 清零；edge_attr permutation 检查边属性是否真的被模型使用；V4 sweep 用更局部的 semantic projection 和 geom-only control 判断语义边是否优于纯空间近邻。

**Urban-form 实验包**检查城市形态是否解释了 edge signal。within-city stratification 按 plot area、building count、street count、building area mean 和 centroid distance 分层；matched-edge probe 在 distance、degree、plot-area gap、node feature L2 上粗匹配；tile-level summary 把城市切成固定网格，观察 local density、label coverage 和 same-label lift proxy。

# 3. 图表解读

Figure 11 说明 label/data 控制是否改变结论。若 downsampling 热图在同一城市内颜色变化很大，说明 label coverage 足以左右 edge 结论；若 balanced 曲线与 original full labels 明显分离，说明类别组成正在影响 same-label probe；若 coarse label 明显强于 original top-1，说明原始 label 粒度可能与聚类任务不完全一致。

```{r fig11, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Figure 11. Label/data controls."}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(fig_dir, "fig_11_label_data_controls.png"))
```

Figure 12 说明 projection rule 是否稳定。Relation ablation delta 大，表示某一类边的加入或删除会显著改变结论；permuted edge-attr dataset 接近 original，表示 edge_attr 可能没有被稳定使用；V4 sweep 中若 geom-only 接近或超过 semantic variants，则城市结果可能被空间几何混杂解释。

```{r fig12, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Figure 12. Projection controls."}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(fig_dir, "fig_12_projection_controls.png"))
```

Figure 13 说明城市形态是否是中介变量或混杂变量。Stratified gain range 大，表示 edge signal 只在特定密度或异质性区间出现；matched point 落到接近零，说明原始 edge gain 可能被距离、度或 plot-area gap 解释；tile-level lift 分布能帮助定位哪些局部片区贡献了 city-level 结果。

```{r fig13, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Figure 13. Urban-form controls."}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(fig_dir, "fig_13_urban_form_controls.png"))
```

Figure 14 是最终诊断矩阵。它不是模型排行榜，而是城市进入下一阶段主实验的风险标注：main anchor 可作为主结果候选；candidate after V4 需要先用 V4 构图修正；negative control 适合作为反例；projection-risk diagnostic 适合专门研究投影规则；not recommended 暂不建议进入主模型 ablation。

```{r fig14, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Figure 14. City decision matrix."}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(fig_dir, "fig_14_city_decision_matrix.png"))
```

# 4. 逐城市证据摘要

下面的表按城市合并三类证据。阅读方式很直接：如果 label/data 项为“是”，先不要把该城市的 edge gain 解释为真实边语义；如果 projection 项为“是”，需要优先检查构图规则；如果 urban-form 项显示“匹配后仍稳定=是”，该城市才更支持独立 edge semantics。

```{r city-table}
if (nrow(city_evidence) == 0) {
  cat("No city-level evidence table was generated.\n")
} else {
  kable(
    city_evidence,
    caption = "City-level evidence summary across the three factor packages.",
    col.names = c("城市", "建议分组", "Label/data 证据", "Projection 证据", "Urban-form 证据")
  )
}
```

# 5. 城市分组建议

```{r group-summary}
group_tbl <- decision |>
  count(decision_group, name = "n_cities") |>
  arrange(desc(n_cities))
if (nrow(group_tbl) == 0) {
  cat("No decision groups were generated.\n")
} else {
  kable(group_tbl, caption = "Final city grouping counts.")
}
```

**main anchor** 城市是后续主模型 ablation 的优先候选，因为它们在匹配控制后仍保留 edge signal，且没有明显 label 或 projection 风险。**candidate after V4** 城市不是不可用，而是需要先用更局部的 V4 构图和 label 粒度控制重新确认。**negative control** 城市对论文同样重要，因为它们能证明方法不是在任何城市上都声称有效。**projection-risk diagnostic** 城市适合写成数据构图机制分析，而不是直接当作主模型胜利案例。**not recommended** 城市暂时不应进入主实验，除非后续数据和构图质量明显改善。

# 6. 失败与剩余风险

```{r failures}
if (nrow(failures) == 0) {
  cat("No package/city failures were recorded.\n")
} else {
  kable(
    failures |>
      select(any_of(c("package", "city", "dataset", "error"))) |>
      mutate(across(everything(), clean_text)),
    caption = "Recorded package or city failures."
  )
}
```

这些实验仍然是数据层和 edge-level probe，不是主 GNN clustering 结果。它们能判断 Urban 城市图是否值得进入主模型实验，但不能单独证明新 GNN 算法优于现有聚类方法。下一步应把 main anchor 和 candidate after V4 分开：前者进入小规模主模型 ablation，后者先扩大 V4 构图搜索并加入外部地形、河流、道路等级、行政边界和经济密度变量。
